script.source:
//@version=5
indicator("uct-hma-macd-parity-v1", overlay=false)
hma20 = ta.hma(close, 20)
[macdLine, signalLine, histLine] = ta.macd(close, 12, 26, 9)
plot(hma20, title="hma20")
plot(macdLine, title="macdLine")
plot(signalLine, title="signalLine")
plot(histLine, title="histLine")

provenance.note: Captured via CSV export (Table view -> Download data) of a real SPY Daily chart with a live ta.hma(close,20)/ta.macd(close,12,26,9) indicator added, full double-precision floats. 2,031 real trading-day bars (2018-08-07..2026-09-04). The HISTOGRAM is the member-composed line-minus-signal, per closedTable.json's own documented convention. It inherits both the line's and the signal's seed-convergence lag (their errors partially offset in the subtraction rather than simply summing -- measured empirically, its own last-disagreement index is NOT simply the later of the two components').

_vendor_parity_warmup_bars_note: 210 is NOT the semantic period-warmup (that is 33 bars, matching the signal's -- the histogram is undefined until both the line and the signal are). It is a conservative round number past the empirically observed convergence point (last disagreeing index measured at 183 of 2,031). Bars 210+ (1,821 of 2,031) never disagree again.
